name: io.usefulapi/helpdocs
title: HelpDocs MCP by usefulapi
description: Search and read articles and reader stats; create and publish article drafts in HelpDocs.

tools.name: helpdocs_list_articles
tools.description: List knowledge base articles, with optional filters by category, tag, language, search term or update time. Set include_body to get article text. Good first call to see what the help center holds. HelpDocs API: GET /v1/article.

category_id.description: Only articles in this category id.

search_term.description: Only articles whose text matches this term.

language_code.description: Language code, for example en (default: the account's default language).

include_body.description: Include each article's body text (larger response).

updated_at_after.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time, as the HelpDocs API accepts it.

updated_at_before.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time, as the HelpDocs API accepts it.

tools.name: helpdocs_get_article
tools.description: Get one article by id: title, body, category, tags, permission groups and publish state. Set working_copy to read the unpublished draft. HelpDocs API: GET /v1/article/{article_id}.

article_id.description: The article id (from helpdocs_list_articles or helpdocs_search_articles).

language_code.description: Language code, for example en (default: the account's default language).

working_copy.description: Read the unpublished working copy instead of the live version.

tools.name: helpdocs_list_article_versions
tools.description: List the saved versions of one article, newest first, to see its edit history. HelpDocs API: GET /v1/article/{article_id}/versions.

article_id.description: The article id (from helpdocs_list_articles or helpdocs_search_articles).

language_code.description: Language code, for example en (default: the account's default language).

before.description: Only versions older than this version number (for paging).

tools.name: helpdocs_list_tags
tools.description: List every article tag in use, with how many articles carry each one. HelpDocs API: GET /v1/article/tags.

language_code.description: Language code, for example en (default: the account's default language).

tools.name: helpdocs_search_articles
tools.description: Full-text search across the account's published articles, with relevance scores. Use it to find the article that answers a question. HelpDocs API: GET /v1/search.

language_code.description: Language code, for example en (default: the account's default language).

category_id.description: Only search inside this category id.

tools.name: helpdocs_list_categories
tools.description: List the categories that organise articles, with their parent links. Set include_article_counts to see how many articles each holds. HelpDocs API: GET /v1/category.

language_code.description: Language code, for example en (default: the account's default language).

include_article_counts.description: Add the article count for each category.

tools.name: helpdocs_get_category
tools.description: Get one category by id: title, description, parent, permission groups and language. HelpDocs API: GET /v1/category/{category_id}.

language_code.description: Language code, for example en (default: the account's default language).

tools.name: helpdocs_list_languages
tools.description: List the languages the account's articles and categories are translated into. HelpDocs API: GET /v1/languages.

tools.name: helpdocs_list_permission_groups
tools.description: List the permission groups that limit which readers may see which articles and categories. HelpDocs API: GET /v1/account/group.

tools.name: helpdocs_list_variables
tools.description: List reusable variables, such as a product name, that articles fill in when they render. HelpDocs API: GET /v1/variable.

tools.name: helpdocs_list_clips
tools.description: List reusable content clips that articles embed, so shared copy is written once. Set template to list only template clips. HelpDocs API: GET /v1/clip.

tools.name: helpdocs_get_top_articles
tools.description: Get the most-viewed articles for a period, to see what readers use most. HelpDocs API: GET /v1/stats/article.

start.description: Start of the period, as the HelpDocs API accepts it (a date string).

end.description: End of the period, as the HelpDocs API accepts it (a date string).

category_id.description: Only articles in this category id.

language_code.description: Language code, for example en (default: the account's default language).

tools.name: helpdocs_get_search_terms
tools.description: Get what readers searched for in the help center during a period, to find missing or unclear articles. HelpDocs API: GET /v1/stats/search.

start.description: Start of the period, as the HelpDocs API accepts it (a date string).

end.description: End of the period, as the HelpDocs API accepts it (a date string).

category_id.description: Only searches made in this category id.

language_code.description: Language code, for example en (default: the account's default language).

tools.name: helpdocs_create_article
tools.description: Create a new article as an unpublished draft in a category. It is not visible to readers until helpdocs_publish_article runs. HelpDocs API: POST /v1/article.

category_id.description: The category id the article belongs to (from helpdocs_list_categories).

body.description: The article body (HTML or Markdown, as the account's editor stores it).

description.description: A short description of the article.

tags.description: Tags to set on the article.

language_code.description: Language code, for example en (default: the account's default language).

tools.name: helpdocs_update_article
tools.description: Change an article's title, body, description, slug, tags or category. The change is saved to the working copy (a draft) and is not live until helpdocs_publish_article runs. HelpDocs API: PATCH /v1/article/{article_id}?working_copy=true.

article_id.description: The article id (from helpdocs_list_articles or helpdocs_search_articles).

tags.description: New tag list (replaces the old tags).

category_id.description: Move the article to this category id.

language_code.description: Language code, for example en (default: the account's default language).

tools.name: helpdocs_publish_article
tools.description: Publish an article's working copy, so readers see the latest draft on the live help center. Readers see it at once. HelpDocs API: POST /v1/article/{article_id}/publish.

article_id.description: The article id (from helpdocs_list_articles or helpdocs_search_articles).

language_code.description: Language code, for example en (default: the account's default language).
